name: @olai/plugin-kit
//exports: TWO doors, because two graphs. The root is the brand mark — a SolidJS `<g>` that opens a nested viewport around a generated body — reached from a plugin's MANIFEST, which already carries SolidJS. `./ref` is the doorbell's one spelling of a pressable node, reached from a plugin's `./server`, which may not pull a UI runtime. `src/mark/emit.ts` is not a door at all: Nix runs it by path.
//: WHAT A PLUGIN'S FACE IN A CONVERSATION IS MADE OF, without knowing which plugin. A tenant declares the pin path of its logo and the node id it is ringing about; this package is the mechanism, said once. It is a SIBLING of `@olai/plugin-api` rather than a door of it: that package imports every plugin, so a plugin importing it is a cycle the manifests cannot express. A third plugin imports this and is not browbeaten to copy a first tenant's internals.
//dependencies: `solid-js` is a runtime dependency of the ROOT door only — `BrandMark` is a component. `./ref` imports nothing. No `@olai/plugin-api` (cycle), no plugin (fence claim 2 the other way), no appliance (this package is general: both tenants reach it, so it is general by the fence's own construction).
